create_logger_for_rl_training: create a Logger instance with a log directory to track RL training metrics to CSV
register_logger_group: register a new logging group with a custom format and dump frequency for the Logger
log_data_to_group: log a dictionary of metrics to a registered Logger group and auto-dump at intervals
create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter to track running averages of values with weighted updates
dump_meters_group: dump a MetersGroup to CSV and console output with formatted metrics and colored prefix
